integrity: The exact proof uses a circulant partial-fraction formula and algebraic root counts, with reproducibility files provided. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for equal-rate directed cycles of dimensions 2 through 8, endpoint matrices and real nonnegative timesteps only; not a claim about larger cycles, variable rates, stage values, or integration error.
title: The first split positive-timestep window for third-order Radau IIA on directed cycles
